items.b: PLATINUM SHEDS $44 TO $1,748 AS ALL FOUR METALS FALL
items.t: Gold gave back $80.40 an ounce to $4,267.30 and silver 2.24%, measured against Friday's final marks on Kitco's bid. Platinum's 2.46% is the largest of the four falls.

items.b: MACY'S RAISES FULL-YEAR SALES GUIDANCE BY $125M AT MIDPOINT
items.t: Fine jewelry was one of five categories named as outperforming in a quarter when comparable sales rose 2.7% and Bloomingdale's rose 11.3%.

items.b: CHRISTIE'S ESTIMATES A DAVID MORRIS RING AT UP TO $2.6M
items.t: A 14.63-carat fancy orangey-pink diamond leads nearly 300 lots from one private collection, sold in Geneva on 10 November and online from 5 to 17 November.

items.b: AMIT SHAH ASKS INDIA TO HOLD THE WHOLE LAB-GROWN CHAIN
items.t: India's home minister named machines, production, jewellery, brands and showrooms in Mumbai on 13 September, and put 2025 gems and jewellery exports at Rs 2.44 lakh crore.

items.b: SIGNET SIGNS THE $125M REPURCHASE WITH JPMORGAN CHASE
items.t: The accelerated agreement is dated 10 September and an initial 1,023,000 shares landed the next day. About $575m of authorisation remains under the 2017 programme.

items.b: LUK FOOK OPENS ITS FIRST UK SHOP AT WESTFIELD STRATFORD
items.t: The Hong Kong group counts about 2,900 points of sale in 14 countries and regions after the London opening on 10 September.

tape_ts: 15 Sep 2026 - Kitco's bid, re-read by the Editor at press time. All four metals had moved off the 05:00 tape, so the fresher reading was written back to Carat Capital's dated tape and to latest.json and prints here: gold 4,267.30, silver 62.93, platinum 1,748.00, palladium 1,266.00. The board carries its own timestamp of Sep 15, 2026 05:59 New York on all four. Changes shown are against the 11 September final marks in Carat Capital's own record, three calendar days back, not Kitco's change field.
